sources.note: Main website. Very sparse — describes Lunar as a stealth technology company building a new type of software system for hospitals. Emphasizes AI, automation, and modern data architecture. No specific feature lists or module descriptions.
Mandatory disclosures page. Failed to render substantive content — appears to be a JavaScript-heavy page that only shows 'ONC Certified' badge. No detailed product disclosures visible.
Interoperability page. Describes read-only HL7 FHIR R4 REST API via EMR Direct's HealthToGo platform (api.healthtogo.me). OAuth-based authentication with SMART clinical scopes. Free to use.
Careers page. Minimal detail — directs to Ashby jobs portal. Describes building 'technology infrastructure for the future of healthcare.'
Privacy notice/terms. Confirms platform is used by hospitals and patients, governed by HIPAA. Separates website data from platform PHI handling.

Job listings (13 open roles). Key roles: Clinical Workflow Informaticist, Hospital Operations Analyst, Fractional Clinical Nursing Informaticist, Fractional Revenue Cycle Specialist. Reveals clinical, revenue cycle, and hospital operations focus areas.

Hospital Operations Analyst job listing. Describes Lunar as 'the world's first AI-native hospital information system.' References implementation with partner health systems and workflow optimization. 11-50 employee range.

Wellfound (AngelList) profile. Confirms 11-50 employees, San Francisco HQ, founding in 2020. Describes platform as powering doctors, nurses, pharmacists, lab technicians, coders, billers, supply chain, and patients.
Crunchbase profile (could not access full content). Confirms investors: Andreessen Horowitz, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Crossover VC, Rogue Capital, SNR.
PitchBook profile (could not access full content). Categorized as Enterprise Systems (Healthcare). Described as cloud-based operating system designed for smaller hospitals.
EMR Direct HealthToGo — the third-party platform providing Lunar's FHIR API endpoints. Provides FHIR client application, APIs, and interoperability services.
